name: vibecoding-start
description: A skill-only Codex plugin that adds lightweight engineering gates, indexed project knowledge, and evidence-based delivery to AI-built software projects.

interface.shortDescription: Keep AI-built projects maintainable from day one
interface.longDescription: VibeCoding Start gives Codex a lightweight, risk-scaled engineering workflow: PRD before code, reuse before custom implementation, indexed project knowledge, independent review, adversarial verification, human acceptance, and rollback-aware release.
defaultPrompt: Use $vibecoding-start to set up this project before coding.
Use $vibecoding-start to review this important change against the project gates.
